title: Hello to his brothers
summary: Morgan sends greetings to Isaiah and Andrew and regrets his brother Robert's death. He plans a trip to New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: That's a great big award. We might take a picture of it so we can see it.
Yes. Your brother would be glad to see it.
Thanks for having me, too. Do you want to say hello to your brother?

Yes, I'll say hello to Isaiah and Andrew. And I wish them the very best of health. And I'm all right myself. And doing pretty good, as a musician do, you know. And I hope everything turned out right. I was very sorry to hear about my brother Robert Pass. Of course, we all have to go that way sometimes, you see. So, later on I might make a trip to New Orleans.
